focus: Q2 part 1, observed breakage after removing sk-code-obsidian and sk-code-webflow and adding an unregistered local surface packet
noveltyJustification: Seven of ten findings are fully new deletion observations, two add partial detail, and one repeats the previously known specs-exclusion route-sync limitation.
keyQuestions: Q2: What breaks when an external user deletes sk-code-obsidian and sk-code-webflow, observed in a throwaway copy, and what happens when they add their own surface?
answeredQuestions: Q2: What breaks when an external user deletes sk-code-obsidian and sk-code-webflow, observed in a throwaway copy, and what happens when they add their own surface?
ruledOut: A surface directory alone is sufficient to register and route a custom mode; the added sk-code-project packet still returns defer.
compiled-route-sync.cjs --check can verify deletion behavior in the prescribed copy; it aborts because specs/ is excluded.
